title: Hear when a session needs you
done: That is it: each speech feature stays off until you turn it on, and works while phonorheos runs.

steps.caption: garnet-scoping can speak through phonorheos, the lab's speaking app, when it runs on this computer.
The speech features are in Settings, under Speech. Here it is.
Turn on what you want to hear: a session that needs you, a session that has finished, an answer on the board, and Read aloud. Try plays each one.
Choose a voice from those phonorheos lists. The status line says whether phonorheos is running.
